clue.text: Twice cook dead bird

indicators.note: Twice asks for the short word for cook to be written two times in a row

parts.note: to do food is to cook it, as in meat well done

explanation.surface: A kitchen instruction to cook something twice, apparently a bird that has already died.
explanation.definitionFit: The flightless Mauritian bird was hunted to extinction, so it is the classic example of a bird long dead.

clue.text: Family member seeing changing of the guard

indicators.note: changing of says the letters of the following words are altered into a new order, playing on the ceremony at Buckingham Palace

explanation.surface: Someone watching the Changing of the Guard ceremony outside Buckingham Palace, the London royal residence.
explanation.definitionFit: A female child is a relative within one's own household, a specific example of a family member.

clue.text: Silly duke at the back of the boat

parts.words: at the back of the boat
parts.note: aft is the nautical word for towards the stern of a vessel

explanation.surface: A foolish nobleman sitting at the stern of a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: Daft is an everyday British synonym for foolish or senseless.

clue.text: Move rider's head on horseback — put his foot here

parts.note: to stir is to move slightly

indicators.note: head says the top, that is the first letter, of the rider is taken

parts.note: a jockey is said to be up when riding a horse

explanation.surface: Instructions to a horseman on where his foot goes once mounted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rider's head' is the first letter of rider; UP is racing language, as in 'with Dettori up'.
explanation.definitionFit: The loop hanging from a saddle is the place where a rider sets each foot, so the description is a functional definition.

clue.text: Strong smell from small fish

parts.note: S is the usual abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
the tench is a freshwater fish of the carp family

explanation.surface: A small fish giving off a powerful odour.
explanation.definitionFit: A stench is a foul, overpowering odour, a synonym for a strong smell.

clue.text: Bury broadcast or put in continuity break

parts.note: to inter is to bury a body

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters of the following words are spread into a new order

explanation.surface: Instructions for a radio or TV programme: bury the story or insert a break in continuity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bury broadcast' tempts as a news phrase, but 'broadcast' only scatters the letters of OR PUT IN.
explanation.definitionFit: A stoppage that halts something running continuously is a synonym phrase for an interruption.

clue.text: Thick end in actual counterargument

indicators.note: in says the thick end goes inside the word for actual

parts.note: actual means real
the butt is the thicker end of a tool, rifle or cigar

explanation.surface: A debater mocking an opponent as the dim end of a real counterargument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Thick' tempts as an insult meaning stupid; here the thick end is the butt of a rifle or cigar.
explanation.definitionFit: A rebuttal is a reply that refutes a claim, a synonym for a counterargument.

clue.text: Composition of lines displayed regularly by pro team

indicators.note: displayed regularly says every other letter of the following words is shown, starting from the first

explanation.surface: A sports team putting its lineup on display in a regular way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Composition of lines' looks like a team formation but is a piece of verse.
explanation.definitionFit: Verse is written in lines, so a composed piece of verse is a composition made up of lines.

clue.text: Overworked forger might have this problem in holding pen

definitions.text: Overworked forger might have this problem in holding pen

parts.words: Overworked forger might have this problem in holding pen
parts.note: a forger is one who writes, and too much of it gives an ache in the hand gripping the pen; the holding pen also hints at the prison cell a forger may end up in

explanation.surface: A busy forger, perhaps locked in a holding pen, suffering an occupational ailment.
explanation.definitionFit: The condition is a painful spasm of the hand muscles caused by prolonged gripping of a pen, typical of someone who writes too much.

clue.text: Parisian's one in favour to receive furniture, to be remembered always

parts.note: un is French for one, as a Parisian would say it
for means in favour of
to get is to receive
a table is a piece of furniture

explanation.surface: A Frenchman's one supportive act of accepting furniture, never to be forgotten.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that cannot be forgotten is, by idiom, something to be remembered always.

clue.text: Latter half of erotic spasm

indicators.note: Latter half of says only the second three letters of the six-letter word that follows are kept

explanation.surface: A racy-sounding reference to an erotic spasm.
explanation.definitionFit: A tic is an involuntary twitch of a muscle, a synonym for a spasm.

clue.text: Those people in front of English subject

indicators.note: in front of says the word for those people comes before the abbreviation for English

parts.note: them means those people

explanation.surface: Some people standing before an English lesson.
explanation.definitionFit: A theme is the topic a talk or essay deals with, a synonym for its subject.

clue.text: Adoption of English as a second language involving power over America

indicators.note: involving says the abbreviation for English as a second language wraps around the other pieces

parts.note: ESL is the usual abbreviation for English as a second language
P is the physics abbreviation for power
O is the cricket scoring abbreviation for an over
USA stands for the United States of America

explanation.surface: An English language course that includes political power over America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' is not a positional indicator here but the letter O, as in cricket scoring.
explanation.definitionFit: To espouse a cause is to take it up, so its espousal is the adoption of that cause or belief.

clue.text: Breathe, stirring hot soothing drink?

indicators.note: stirring means mixing up, so the letters of the word before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: Breathing in the steam while stirring a hot, calming drink.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the definition as an example: a tisane is one kind of soothing hot drink.
explanation.definitionFit: An infusion of herbs such as camomile is a typical warm, calming beverage, so it is an example of the definition.

clue.text: Unsettled year when in no particular place

indicators.note: Unsettled means disturbed from its order, so the letters of the following words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A restless year spent wandering, with no fixed abode.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb means at any location whatever, the same as in no particular place.

clue.text: Old saint put in mature, clever reply

indicators.note: put in says the old saint letters are placed inside the word for mature

parts.note: ripe means mature

explanation.surface: An elderly, wise saint giving a sharp answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A riposte is a quick, witty retort, so it is a synonym for a clever reply.

clue.text: Part of rarely seen French palace

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A section of a French palace that few visitors ever see.
explanation.definitionFit: The Paris palace on the rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré is the official residence of the French president.

clue.text: After referendum, it's unknown who wants a cracker?

indicators.note: After says the unknown letter comes following the word for referendum

parts.note: a referendum is a poll of voters
Y is one of the letters used for an unknown in algebra

explanation.surface: Following a vote, nobody knows who is after a cracker.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition plays on the catchphrase 'Polly wants a cracker', said to a pet parrot.
explanation.definitionFit: The stock name for a pet parrot, which in the familiar phrase asks for a biscuit, so it is a cryptic description.

clue.text: Fate of man whose wife turned to salt

definitions.meaning: one's fate is one's destiny or portion in life

definitions.text: man whose wife turned to salt
definitions.meaning: in Genesis, the wife of Abraham's nephew looked back at Sodom and became a pillar of salt

explanation.surface: A question about the fate of the biblical man whose wife became salt.
explanation.definitionFit: One's lot is one's destiny; and in the Bible he was the man who fled Sodom while his wife turned to salt.

clue.text: Tool commercials on the radio

indicators.note: on the radio says the word is heard rather than read, so its sound is what counts

parts.note: ads are commercials

explanation.surface: A hardware tool being advertised in radio commercials.
explanation.definitionFit: An adze is a woodworking implement with an arched blade set at right angles to its handle.

clue.text: Icy shower is welcome

definitions.meaning: pellets of ice falling from clouds
to greet someone with a call or salute

explanation.surface: A storm of ice pellets being greeted gladly.
explanation.definitionFit: Frozen rain pellets fall as a storm of ice, and to call out a greeting to someone is to welcome them.

clue.text: Unemotional lives go by, one likely to interrupt romantic meeting

indicators.note: to interrupt says the other pieces break into the word for a romantic meeting

parts.note: a date is a romantic meeting
is means lives or exists
to pass is to go by
I is the Roman numeral for one
on means likely, as in 'the deal is on'

explanation.surface: Life passes by while someone keeps barging into a romantic evening.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to interrupt' puts ISPASSION between D and ATE.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone dispassionate is calm and free of strong feeling, a synonym for unemotional.

clue.text: Overshadow cuts within Europe's borders

indicators.note: within says the word for cuts is placed between the border letters
borders asks for the first and last letters of Europe, its edges

parts.note: clips means cuts, as with shears

explanation.surface: Budget cuts inside Europe's frontiers overshadowing everything.
explanation.definitionFit: To eclipse something is to outshine it or cast it into the shade, a synonym for overshadow.

clue.text: Stick contents of bulges out

indicators.note: out means put out of order, so the inner letters are rearranged
contents of says only the inner letters of the word, without its first and last, are used

explanation.surface: Pulling the stuffing out of something that bulges.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contents of' keeps ULGE from bulges, and 'out' rearranges it.
explanation.definitionFit: Glue is an adhesive, and as a verb it means to stick things together.
